answer.mixedWhat: Recognition source views and lexical mapping/adjudication routes, not a local interpolation/physical-glyph measurement blend.

codeEvidence.supports: VNRecognizeTextRequest accurate/en-US/no language correction; regex whitespace spans passed to VNRecognizedText.boundingBox(for:). Missing ranges produce null, not guessed boxes. Text-candidate confidence is emitted at observation level.
Normalized bottom-left API rectangle is affine-mapped to the known original crop frame. This is coordinate conversion, not token-width interpolation.
Duplicate groups choose one existing observed rectangle by longer observation/context/confidence; they do not average or split a box.

Canonical token identity is matched over all optimal edit alignments. A unique match with observation confidence>=0.5 supplies its existing box. The copied confidence is whole recognized candidate/observation confidence, not an independent glyph-edge calibration.
Whole-row source view selected lexically; seven frozen visual token substitutions copy the unique observed raw box unchanged.

fieldMeanings.verified: Canonical token-to-observation mapping, with seven source-pixel identity adjudications; not independently certified glyph containment.
fieldMeanings.humanVerified: False for every word; source AI review is explicitly not human verification.
fieldMeanings.confidence: Inherited recognized text-candidate/observation confidence; not per-pixel support or physical bbox error certainty.
fieldMeanings.centerUncertaintyPx: Heuristic review guard, usually3 pixels plus duplicate-center disagreement; not a calibrated bound.
fieldMeanings.box: Approximate OCR text-range rectangle in row-specific rotated coordinates.
fieldMeanings.originalUprightPolygon: Inverse coordinate mapping of that rectangle, not a measured glyph contour.
fieldMeanings.rawObservations/rawWords/rawOCRWordId: Evidence chain to API response, retained so a box can be audited without trusting the final label.
fieldMeanings.selectedSourceView/sourceCropSha256: Which fixed representation generated the chosen API ranges;101words use processed2x representations.
fieldMeanings.punctuationOnlyTokens: Fifteen standalone punctuation identities outside the lexical word unit; their old locations are null. They still require source ownership/support in a new fixture.
fieldMeanings.punctuationOrCaseDifference: Flags any literal canonical/OCR difference. Machine identity normalizes away case/punctuation; an accepted token association therefore does not certify attached punctuation is inside the OCR range box.

coordinateAndPhotometricLimits: Row frames are2544x3264, top-left origin, after the declared fixed-center rotation. Page79 first paragraph uses2.5degrees; other rows0.
Second-pass source crops use gray/autocontrast or fixed dark/light thresholds and2x LANCZOS scaling. A copied API box from those representations is not direct native-pixel segmentation.

Source-preparation rotation explicitly sets white fill; frozen G04 rotate call leaves fill unspecified. Keep native pixels and every future frame/fill mapping explicit; this audit did not measure whether any inspected glyph is affected.
No Apple implementation internals or original typesetting font metrics are exposed. Numeric regularity alone does not establish how the framework internally localizes a substring.

substantiveSupportPath.basis: Use source pixel/component ownership independent of the OCR rectangle, consistent with the already proposed MASK_MECHANISM; no execution in this audit.
steps: Freeze predeclared native source-context windows with full neighboring-row/word context, extending beyond old OCR boxes. Do not clip candidate support to the old ROI before annotation.

Build both fixed photometric candidate layers on those source pixels: dark maxRGB<130 and light minRGB>170 with spread<70. No edge-median polarity decision, threshold tuning, gap or decoder output. Label all8-connected components with stable pixel/source IDs; keep noise/background candidates too.

Source-review canonical-token ownership of components. Include attached punctuation and give every standalone punctuation token its own identity. Mark highlighter/page fields, art, strike-through, neighbor glyphs and ambiguous bridges separately.

For each token, independently review the full candidate component union against unmodified source context: glyph inclusion, diacritics/descenders/punctuation, foreign support and context-border clipping. A second pass confirms or rejects membership before any extent is measured.

Certify containment only from this reviewed support: all reviewed possible-support pixels/envelope inside the proposed ROI => contained; definite glyph support outside => not contained; uncertainty intersecting the ROI edge => unknown. Definite-support and fringe-boundary intervals can establish clear yes/no cases without claiming every antialias pixel is known.

Freeze accepted source masks/component membership and unknowns. Only a later separately registered routine may measure extents/gaps while retaining the declared original encoding. No source annotation may be chosen by decoded language, acceptance count or key validity.
substantiveSupportPath.positivePilotFeasibility: Existing source-only pilot recognizes readable dark-on-paper tokens and light-on-dark/orange tokens, including two standalone dashes. These provide concrete visibility classes for component ownership, but its coarse enclosures are not yet support masks. A bounded whole-row pilot can prove at least clear support cases before scaling to all1258 identities.
substantiveSupportPath.requiredFirstDeliverable: A source-pinned component atlas plus independent token membership/contamination/containment review for a fixed complete pilot population, yielding actual accepted masks where source permits—not a copied-box/all-unknown skeleton.
substantiveSupportPath.currentSourcePilotState: 22 qualitative token classifications and2coarse dash locators; zero measurement-ready supports. The mask mechanism exists as an unexecuted proposal.

limits: All1243 exact lineage checks establish where locators came from, not that any box encloses every physical glyph pixel.
Canonical-token verification is normalized identity, not glyph-by-glyph coverage; attached punctuation and visually adjudicated character confusions need independent physical-support proof.
This audit classified no token as glyph-contained or noncontained, and produced no new raster mask, threshold statistic, measured ink bound or detector repair.
Only a fixed source-ownership fixture can resolve physical support; keep illegible/connected/occluded cases unknown without declaring all readable tokens unknowable.
